title: SotV
description: Adds some items from VotV game
body:
Susoids of the Void (SotV)

Susoids of the Void is a content mod that adds a variety of new items, blocks, food, and decorative elements from VotV to enhance your Minecraft experience.

 

New Food Items

  • Raw Shrimp & Cooked Shrimp — Cook shrimp in a furnace for a tasty snack!
  • Chicken Burger — A satisfying meal to keep you going during adventures
  • MRE — Military-style rations for survival situations
  • Unknown Substance — A mysterious consumable that grants Speed II and Jump Boost II for 5 minutes. Perfect for quick escapes or parkour challenges!

 

Waste Management System

Sort and manage different types of waste with specialized tiles:

  • Plastic Tile & Plastic Trash
  • Electronic Tile & Electronic Trash
  • Rubber Tile & Rubber Trash
  • Wooden Tile & Wooden Trash
  • Paper Tile & Paper Trash
  • Mop — A special tool that quickly breaks all tile blocks and cobwebs. Keep your world clean

 

Custom Paintings & Decorations

Add personality to your builds with 10 unique paintings:

  • 6 Ariral Graffiti-style artworks
  • 2 Posters
  • Special themed paintings
  • Decorative Argemia plush blocks in Red, Green, and Blue variants

 

Special Items

  • Ariralizer — A powerful tool that toggles between two modes:
          Ariral Mode: Grants Invisibility + Night Vision
          Visible Mode: Removes invisibility, grants Speed IV + Jump Boost III + Night Vision
  • GM Swapper — Utility item for change GameMode between survival and creative
